we are witnessing the development of a “new” event-tourism market segment, with the characteristics of event tourism becoming more and more intertwined with the characteristics of sports tourism.

event tourism is a form of tourism that is based on a consumption constellation of a portfolio of sports and other activities, and that event tourists develop event-tourism careers that may be based on the pursuit of personal challenge, or on a combination of personal challenge and social interaction with others.
